name: T3rnel Browser MCP Bridge
description: The local MCP bridge that drives the user's real browser through the T3rnel Browser extension — 97 tools for navigation, input, reading, screenshots, recording, audits and session management.

mcp.transport: stdio (local bridge — no remote endpoint; the browser the user is on is the server)
mcp.authentication: pairing or auto-approve per the extension's Settings; a policy firewall may gate tools
